message: Jongmin, we're running a small builder's dinner in SF next month with folks grinding on developer tools, LLM tooling, and ML infra—Louan, Stiven Ding, Colin, and a few others doing real work in the space. Your conviction that LLMs with proper engineering can solve hard math and science problems feels directly relevant to what people are building, and your agent-guided system design work would add something different to the room. Want in?
